name: INRIA V1 PLY Splat Parsing
definition: Parses raw INRIA V1 PLY splat data into an uncompressed splat structure, handling coordinate systems, scale exponentiation, opacity sigmoid, and spherical harmonic (SH) coefficient mapping.
summary: INRIA V1 PLY Splat Parsing decodes INRIA 3D Gaussian Splatting PLY files into uncompressed splat arrays, dynamically handling variable-length spherical harmonics unlike fixed-width binary formats.
